india_trends.title: Can Coal India’s higher realizations sustain its stock recovery?
india_trends.summary: Coal India’s higher e-auction premiums and tighter coal inventories are supporting realizations, but rising production and falling e-auction volumes could test the recovery.

india_trends.title: JK Cement’s timely capacity ramp-ups give it bandwidth to beat FY27 volume goals
india_trends.summary: JK Cement’s new Panna line-2 capacity, strong demand in north and central India and a rising green-power share could support FY27 volume growth, though higher capex and fuel costs may keep debt and margins under pressure.

india_trends.title: Usha Martin sells optical fibre manufacturing business to R R Kabel for Rs 77 crore
india_trends.summary: Usha Martin (UML) said that the company's board has approved a proposal for the slump sale of the business undertaking of U M Cables, wholly owned subsidiary, to R R Kabel for a total consideration of Rs 77 crore.

india_trends.title: Transport Corp surges as board to mull buyback proposal
india_trends.summary: Transport Corporation of India zoomed 13.12% to Rs 942.95 after the company announced that its board will meet on 29 September 2026 to consider a proposal for buyback of fully paid-up equity shares.

india_trends.title: Cabinet to soon decide on new bilateral investment treaty template to ease dispute settlements
india_trends.summary: The proposed model will substantially shorten the five-year mandatory litigation timeframe for companies under the existing 2015 template before pursuing global arbitration for dispute settlement.

india_trends.title: Small-cap IT stock under ₹50 jumps 17% as US subsidiary gets AI project worth ₹147 crore
india_trends.summary: Blue Cloud's subsidiary, GIX, secured a $15.5 million order from IBM Cloud for AI infrastructure services within three months of joining. The project focuses on building scalable systems for AI workloads, with strict performance standards set for availability and incident response.

india_trends.title: Balrampur Chini Mills shares rally 4% as company receives Rs 75 crore BioE3 grant from government
india_trends.summary: Balrampur Chini Mills shares gained after the government awarded a Rs 75 crore BioE3 grant for a 100 TPA PLA co-polymer R&D facility at its Kumbhi manufacturing complex in Uttar Pradesh.

india_trends.title: Adani Power shares up over 30% in last 6 months - PL Capital sees a further 30% upside - Price target, rationale
india_trends.summary: Adani Power's shares have climbed over 30% in the past six months, with PL Capital predicting an additional 30% upside. The company aims to expand its capacity significantly by FY32, positioning itself as a major player in India's energy sector amidst strong earnings and declining debt.

india_trends.summary: Hong Kong stocks declined sharply on Friday, led by technology and AI shares, as investors awaited clarity from the Trump-Xi summit. india_trends.title: OFSS shares tumble 5% after Oracle sends 'force majeure' notice for data centre project. Are AI worries coming true?
india_trends.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software (OFSS) shares tumbled over 5% after parent company Oracle issued a force majeure notice regarding a massive New Mexico AI data centre project. The development triggered financing concerns across AI infrastructure, sending OFSS stock to a nine-week low of Rs 10,332

india_trends.title: Double QIP action: Inox Green, Wheels India shares soar as fundraises kick off- Check floor price, discount, other info
india_trends.summary: Inox Green Energy and Wheels India shares rose following their QIP fundraise announcements. Inox aims to raise ₹300 crore with a share price floor of ₹174.36, while Wheels plans ₹250 crore at ₹2,197.10 per share, both potentially offering a 5% discount.
